_status: DRAFT for freeze (M0b engine owner: Kimi C per 00-TEAM.md 2026-11-16). Appearance schema v2 — Fluent 3D emoji avatars. B and D build against THIS file; changes go through Claude to Kimi C.

appearance._comment: Age is NOT stored; stages are derived at render (see age_stages). person_id stays on the Person object (integration.ensure_person_id); appearance keeps only `seed` for deterministic aging.

seed.note: preserved from v1; drives deterministic aging

base.note: independent of gameplay gender; default derived from gender at generation, 'person' when unknown (e.g. standalone migration)

hair.note: 'white' is also applied by ageing at render time (greying/elder stages) when hair != bald

facial_hair.note: adults only; engine clears it for babies/children

badges.note: corner badges on the portrait, not drawn on the face

look_override.note: set by game state (job, wedding); renderer uses it when the asset exists, else the regular look

greying.effect: effective hair -> white when hair != bald

migration_v1_to_v2._comment: lossy but stable; keeps seed; base='person' unless the owning Person's gender is supplied (integration refines it)
migration_v1_to_v2.skin_tone: v1 skin_01..12 ordered light->dark map pairwise into [default, light, medium-light, medium, medium-dark, dark]
migration_v1_to_v2.hair: hair_texture in (curly, coily) -> curly; hair_color in (red, auburn) -> red; hair_style == bald -> bald; hair_color in (white, gray) -> white; else default
migration_v1_to_v2.badges: [glasses if v1 accessories.glasses != none] + [earrings if v1 accessories.earrings != none] + [cap if v1 accessories.headwear == cap], capped at 2

generation_rules.random: uniform picks per field via the caller's rng; age-appropriate pass after
generation_rules.inheritance: skin_tone: one parent's tone (50/50) or the in-between tone when both known (documented 50% chance of in-between); hair: either parent's hair; NEVER inherit badges or headwear (fresh random); facial_hair none until adulthood
generation_rules.age_appropriate: baby/child: badges=[], facial_hair=none, headwear=none; beard only from stage teen_adult; badges capped at 2 always

newborn_migrated._comment: v1 save data migrated; parents' genders unknown at data level so base='person'

_render_at_64._note: hair->white derived at render; stored hair stays 'default'

bride_look_override._render_note: wedding sets look_override=bride/groom; renderer falls back to the regular look if the asset is missing

baby_guardrails._comment: what the engine enforces regardless of input data
baby_guardrails.rule: generation and age_appropriate never produce beards/badges/headscarves on babies

renderer_contract._comment: for Kimi B: avatar_image_key(appearance, age, context) resolves through D's manifest; person chip = image in a circle on appearance.background colour, badges in the corner; render_avatar_svg is deleted with this switch
renderer_contract.look_override_source: game state sets it (engine never invents job looks); unknown/missing asset -> regular look

asset_pipeline._comment: for Kimi D: tools/fetch_fluent_avatars.py per M0b spec; key space implied by the fields above
